title: P15.10-C R4: final readiness & cost proof — claim() predicate shared with readiness, broken-lineage fail-close, in-txn pricing identity
description: R4 remediation on PR #87 (BASE 0e27bc6ee236d82633d4aee321ba9cd264adc0c3): targeted audit fixes proven by prepatch FAIL -> postpatch PASS (12/17 R4 tests failed pre-fix). F3: readiness() could report READY while claim() would deny — it checked only queue-state quarantine/blocked. New scheduler.queueEligibility() is claim()'s OWN predicate (queue state, pending generation, next_due, attempt cooldown) and public claimable() adds the authority pins (effective policy, binding pins) plus active-lease check; driver.readiness() consumes claimable() — no second scheduler; read-only, owner-scoped, no wake/lease side effects. Reasons: NO_QUEUE, QUEUE_<state>, NO_PENDING_GENERATION, NOT_DUE_YET, ATTEMPT_COOLDOWN, POLICY_NOT_EFFECTIVE, STALE_BINDING, LEASE_HELD + SCHEDULER_NOT_READY/COST_UNVERIFIED/COST_BINDING_UNVERIFIED/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; driver_integrated vs objective_runnable distinguished; driver_missing carries real reasons. F2-A: mission with objective-binding lineage missing/contradictory (wob row gone, work_item gone, item-claim vs allocation mismatch) -> FAIL_CLOSED_COST_OBJECTIVE_UNVERIFIED, never treated as manual; truly manual missions unaffected. objectiveScopeFor resolves binding-claim via work_item.objective_id then bounded parent-chain walk (cycle/mid-chain-missing -> BROKEN) plus allocation linkage. F2-B: billingFor/requested re-resolved INSIDE the atomic check-and-reserve txn — a profile/route edit committed after the advisory outer read can never slip a stale price; in-txn UNKNOWN/unbounded deny mirrors outer fast-path; in-txn resId re-check (COMMITTED/SETTLED adopt, unexpected HELD -> AMBIGUOUS). F2-C: real cross-connection race proof — sibling reservation committed at txn entry is seen and denied (never double-reserve over cap). Test hygiene per mandate: F3f split into quarantined vs budget-exhausted; EXPIRED proof now uses a real expires_at deadline, never a 2999 fixture bump. R1/R2 audited code verbatim. No merge/deploy; driver OFF.
